project.name: SFS Reconstruction
project.description: SFS Reconstruction Model subsystem : the frozen model contract, the deterministic baseline renderer, the semantic DNA, structure, fact/entity and relationship encoders, the tiny decoder interface with its default implementation, the constraint interface, the reproducible benchmark harness and the future-training hook. The model consumes Semantic DNA and Reconstruction Rules and can never silently invent unsupported critical facts. It has no dependency on the Memory DB or Search subsystems, so it can be replaced without touching them.
